tools.name: list_programacao
tools.description: Channels with a collected TV guide, up to 48 per page.

tools.name: get_programacao
tools.description: The last TV guide available for the channel and up to 20 dates of its history.

tools.name: get_programacao_dia
tools.description: The stored TV guide of a channel on one day. We collect and organize the available schedules. Read the channel and date you need instead of building an EPG collection process. Check available dates. The schedule is metadata; it does not provide a video archive or broadcast rights.

tools.name: api_index
tools.description: The index of the whole API, with the languages and the HTML pages of each language.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: The countries in the catalog, with the playable count and the flag URL (`kind=radio` counts stations).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: The tags of the playable radio stations, with the count, optionally by country.

tools.name: search_channels
tools.description: Searches public channels (filters: q, country, category, language, network, quality, playable; kind=radio for radio stations, tag for a radio tag; sort=score orders by the health that a third party measures, sort=votes by the radio votes; online=1 returns only channels seen online in the last 48 h).

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: The languages that have a playable channel, with the count of each language.

tools.name: get_channel
tools.description: The full record of a channel, with the streams that already point to our hop.

tools.name: get_channel_guide
tools.description: Today's TV guide of the channel (recorded by us): now, next and the list. It is available for the channels with a guide (`guide=1`) and is valid for up to two days. Check the date of the response; the channel record has the summary in `guide_now`.

tools.name: get_library
tools.description: The whole library of the owner: folders, tabs, channels and the feed URLs of each level.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Adds a channel to a tab. 40 channels at most per tab. The response tells the folder and the tab where the channel went, so the screen opens in the right place. The response has the whole updated library, so you do not need to reload `GET /api/library`.

tools.name: tv_state
tools.description: Checks the TV device's activation by its six-digit code. The network is the fallback for clients without a playback cookie or UUID.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_countries, get_library, pricing · Private data: search_channels, get_channel, get_channel_guide, tv_pass, pricing, get_api_x402_programacao_by_slug · Public sink: get_programacao_dia, get_api_x402_programacao_by_slug.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_countries, get_library, pricing · Private data: search_channels, get_channel, get_channel_guide, tv_pass, pricing, get_api_x402_programacao_by_slug · Public sink: get_programacao_dia, get_api_x402_programacao_by_slug

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
